title: Normal finite models dominating a surface modification
statement: Let $R\hookrightarrow S$ be a finite injective local homomorphism of commutative normal Nagata local domains of dimension $2$ [def-weil-finitely-generated-module, def-weil-pbc-normal-ring, def-weil-pbc-nagata-ring, def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. For every normal modification $Y\to\operatorname{Spec}S$ [def-per-rational-surface-singularity], there exist normal modifications $X\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ and $Y_1\to\operatorname{Spec}S$, a proper birational $S$-morphism $h:Y_1\to Y$ (that is, proper and inducing the identity on the common function field), and a finite morphism $\pi:Y_1\to X$ [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] for which the two composites $Y_1\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ agree. No separability assumption on the fraction fields is required.
